reason: Both identify the identical root cause (ESCALATE_MARGIN=0.5 instead of 5.0) and the identical downstream mechanism: the escalation band is shrunk to a tenth of its intended width, causing near-miss VMAF scores that should escalate to a higher preset tier to instead resolve to RejectedTerminal — reproducing a narrow version of the dead-band bug the PR was meant to fix. The reviewer adds concrete supporting evidence (doc comment, specific test cases and boundary math) but this is elaboration of the same mechanism, not a different bug.
